title: Unprompted coordination through shared memory in LLM agents
experiment_or_implementation_evidence: 4 agents; 9 models; two independently built implementations; shared key-value store; locked design/data/analysis; Zenodo replication package
reproducibility: High for the narrow task; replication package DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23965306
limitations: Small arithmetic task; endpoint/parser/effort differences affected some cells; access and influence supported but intent not established
architecture_relevance: Treat all shared state as a communication channel; namespace and log cross-agent reads; distinguish access/influence/intent

title: Scaling Multi-Agent Intelligence with Substrate-Centric Coordination
experiment_or_implementation_evidence: 4 agentic tasks; 2 model backbones; comparisons with ReAct, MAD, AOrchestra and DeLM; bounded top-k search; scale up to 128 agents; failure/dropout tests
reproducibility: Detailed paper and benchmark protocol; no explicit ScaleMAS author code repository confirmed in inspected paper text
limitations: Limited to 128 agents; inference-time substrate; citation count is not a truth guarantee
architecture_relevance: Bounded retrieval; persistent linked messages; flexible membership; rank with provenance and independent validation

title: Waggle: Learning One Anonymous Local Law for Self-Organizing LLM Swarms
experiment_or_implementation_evidence: Shared anonymous local policy; Swarm-Consistent Distillation; multiple coordination settings; delay/loss/churn interventions; detailed appendices and protocols
reproducibility: Detailed protocols and appendices; no explicit author code repository confirmed in inspected paper text
limitations: Fixed deterministic adapter/runtime; no arbitrary schedules, permanent loss or adversarial agents; anonymous interface excludes persistent identity reputation
architecture_relevance: Local reaction policy; bounded view; reversible commitments; runtime validation remains deterministic

title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents
experiment_or_implementation_evidence: 800-tick study with 48 episodes; separate 3200-tick study; N=50/100/200; eight paired held-out disturbances; agent-free artifact evaluation
reproducibility: Open code, prompt manifests, protocols, raw outputs, analysis scripts and HuggingFace dataset
limitations: Controlled spatial/material simulator; not a real enterprise workflow; simulation-to-reality transfer remains unproven
architecture_relevance: Persistent artifacts, external memory, artifact lineage, post-agent evaluation and world consequence separation

title: Capable language models can outgrow the benefits of collaboration
experiment_or_implementation_evidence: 260 configurations; 6 benchmarks; 5 architectures; 3 model families; matched task/tools/compute; within-domain architecture selection
reproducibility: Published article with supplementary material and source data
limitations: Strong domain heterogeneity; about 45% is an empirical selection heuristic not a universal law; cross-domain generalization is limited
architecture_relevance: Require single-agent baseline and matched-budget cost/quality evaluation before multi-agent admission

title: DEDMAC: Disentangling Environment and Decision Messages for Multi-Agent Communication
experiment_or_implementation_evidence: Separates environment messages from decision-intent messages in cooperative MARL; benchmark evaluation
reproducibility: Published article with method and experiment sections
limitations: MARL framework, not direct LLM Agent Ecology evidence
architecture_relevance: Keep environment facts and decision intents as separate message/event types

title: Deep reinforcement learning for multi-agent coordination
experiment_or_implementation_evidence: Stigmergic multi-agent DRL using virtual pheromones and curriculum learning; tested up to 5 deterministic and 8 stochastic agents
reproducibility: Open-access paper with method and experimental results
limitations: Robot/DRL setting, not LLM agent ecosystem; small population and specific retrieval task
architecture_relevance: Use as a non-LLM baseline for trace fields, local feedback and decentralized coordination
